   City Council Special Meeting Agenda
  Tuesday, January 15, 2019

  CALL TO ORDER
  ROLL CALL: Mayor Harrington, Vice Mayor Pu, Council Members Costanzo, Liao,
  Menchaca

1.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  Pursuant to provisions of the Government Code §54957, this is the time provided
  for members of the public to address the City Council regarding matters on this
  Agenda.

2.  CLOSED SESSION

  A. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – EXISTING LITIGATION

  The City Council will meet in a closed session, pursuant to Government Code
  §54956.9, to discuss “Flores v. City of San Gabriel”, for the following
  purpose: Conference with Legal Counsel - Existing Litigation.

  B. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION

  The Council will meet in a closed session with legal counsel to discuss a matter
  that the City Attorney has determined poses a significant exposure to litigation
  pursuant to Government Code §54956.9 (d)(2) - (one potential case).

3.  STUDY SESSION: 5 YEAR FINANCIAL FORECAST

  The purpose of this study session is to help the City Council make informed
  budgetary and operational decisions by anticipating future revenues and
  expenditures, and highlighting anticipated fiscal risks and opportunities. The
  forecast surfaces major known fiscal conditions and projected future conditions to
  support informed long-term planning and decision making regarding operational
  and capital improvement resources such as expenditures, labor negotiations,
  economic development policies, and revenue policies as well as prioritizing
  competing needs of the City’s operations.

4.  ADJOURN COUNCIL MEETING

  The next regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, January 15, 2019 at
  6:30 p.m. in the Council Chamber at City Hall, 425 South Mission Drive, San Gabriel,

MINUTES  OF JANUARY  15, 2019

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

CALL TO ORDER

Mayor Harrington called the special meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at
5: 30 p. m. on Tuesday, January 15, 2019, in City Hall Council Chamber at City Hall, 425
South Mission  Drive, San Gabriel, California, 91776.

ROLL CALL

Council  Members  Present:  Juli  Costanzo,  Chin Ho Liao, Denise  Menchaca,  Vice

  Mayor Jason Pu, John Harrington, and Mayor.
Council Members Absent:  None.
Staff Members  Present:  City  Manager  Mark  Lazzaretto;  City Attorney  Keith

  Lemieux; Human Resources/  Risk Management  Director
  Rayna  Ospina;Community Development  Director
  Armine Chaparyan; Chief City Clerk Sharon Clark and

  Assistant City Clerk Marilyn Bonus.

1.  PUBLIC COMMENT —None.

2.  CLOSED SESSION

  The City Council recessed to Closed Session at 5: 31 p. m.

  A. CONFERENCE  WITH  LEGAL  COUNSEL —  EXISTING  LITIGATION (  Government
  Code § 54956. 9)

  Case: Flores v. City of San Gabriel

  B.  CONFERENCE  WITH  LEGAL  COUNSEL —  ANTICIPATED  LITIGATION
  Government  Code § 54956. 9 [ d][ 2])
  One potential case

  The City Council reconvened into Open Session at 6: 32 p. m.; no reportable action.
RECESS AND RECONVENE

  The special meeting was recessed at 6: 32 p. m., to be resumed after the regular
  meeting.

  The special meeting was reconvened at 8: 38 p. m. with all council members present.

3.  STUDY SESSION:  5 YEAR FINANCIAL  FORECAST

  Financial  Services  Manager  Shaoyin  Wei  presented  the  City' s five- year financial
  forecast.

  Following  a  brief discussion,  the City Council gave direction for staff to  gather

  information relative to placing a transaction and use tax ballot measure on a special

   election in November 2019. Vice Mayor Pu also requested additional forecasts for a
  combination  of Options  1 and 2, both with and without the debt service to fund the
  Police Station, for future Council discussions.

4.  ADJOURNMENT

  The City Council meeting was adjourned at 9: 28 p. m.
